bagPolicy.summary: Bags cannot exceed 12" x 6" x 12". Larger bags must be checked at the Guest Services booth.
allowed: One factory sealed plastic water bottle
prohibited: Professional cameras (detachable lenses or lenses over 2")
bagPolicy.note: Bags over the size limit are checked at the Guest Services booth. Strollers are checked and held at Guest Services. Cameras are subject to artist approval.
